criticalOverrides.note: Critical means signing, money, queue and auth (D1, 2026-09-28). The prefixes are critical as a whole. exact lists every other Shared source file whose code reaches a primitive in sharedMutationPrimitives. The selector also escalates any changed Shared file that reaches one, and select-validation.test.mjs fails when exact drifts from the code.

These data-only builders define the owner's Kernel permission install and independent revoke calls. Their authorization payloads are critical even though they do not themselves invoke a signing or sending primitive.

sharedMutationPrimitives.note: Calls that sign, send a transaction, move funds, or change auth, session or queue state, read from the Shared code (scripts/quality/shared-mutation-surface.mjs). external and internal name the functions, hooks and classes whose call is the act, and passing one on as a value carries it; members name methods whose call, read or destructuring is the act, such as sender.sendContractCall(), onClick={auth.signOut} or const { signOut } = useAuth(). A member forwarded under its own name, as useAuth() does, keeps only its own file critical.

sharedConsumerTestSupport.note: Shared test support that Client and Admin tests import: @green-goods/shared/testing and the base test setup. For those consumers it is test infrastructure rather than Shared's own tests, so a change reaches their suites and workflows as Shared source does.
